gui.guhs.wardrobe.title: %s's Wardrobe
gui.guhs.launch.cooldown: Your guh is still catching its breath (%s s)
gui.guhs.personality.playful.description: Does happy little laps now and then. A bit faster than other guhs.
gui.guhs.personality.lazy.description: Slower, and would rather just lie around.
gui.guhs.personality.vadsig.description: Sniffs up cheese nibbles off the ground and eats them. Easier to tame.
gui.guhs.personality.shy.description: Wild: keeps away from you, unless you're holding cheese nibbles. Harder to tame.
gui.guhs.personality.brave.description: Hits harder and never runs away.
gui.guhs.personality.chatty.description: Makes guh noises twice as often.
gui.guhs.personality.cuddly.description: Now and then heals their owner half a heart when they're close by.
gui.guhs.personality.curious.description: Walks up to nearby players to get a good look at them.
gui.guhs.protected.no_fire: No fire or buckets next to a guh building, nyeg!
gui.guhs.emotes.title: %s's Emotes
gui.guhs.emotes.loop.tooltip: Keeps doing it until you press Stop (or something happens, like getting hurt).
gui.guhs.emotes.favourite.tooltip: Make this the favorite emote: your guh will do it on their own now and then.
gui.guhs.emotes.stop.tooltip: Stop the emote they're doing right now.
gui.guhs.emotes.favourite.clear.tooltip: Your guh won't do emotes on their own anymore (only when you ask).
gui.guhs.emotes.busy: Nyeg! Not right now, they're busy.
gui.guhs.emotes.alleen_voor: Only the %s can do that! Nyeg.
gui.guhs.knus.binnenkort_lang: More cozy is coming here soon! Nyeg, just a little more patience...
gui.guhs.knus.kies: Click a section to see its milestones and collections
gui.guhs.knus.klik_item: Click a picture (or hover over it) to read what it is.
gui.guhs.knus.nog_niet: ??? Not discovered yet. Nyeg, keep looking!
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal_bereikt: Cozy milestone: %s! Claim your reward in your Guhdex (Cozy tab). WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.seizoenen_bladerh: Jumped into a leaf pile ten times
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelvriendjes.burgemees: The mayor of Snuggledale. He loves parties, lists and his chain of office. Mostly parties.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelvriendjes.cocotje.i: OH YEAH THEY HANG ON MY CHONK. 'Cause you so wahoog. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelvriendjes.opa_guh.i: Sits on his bench by the campfire and knows everything about the old days. The VERY old days.
gui.guhs.knus.seizoensplakboek.lente_kra: In spring the season planters bloom. Three flowers on top: a blossom wreath!
gui.guhs.knus.seizoensplakboek.lente_guh: A guh with a blossom wreath
Your tame guh wore a blossom wreath in spring. So sweet, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knus.seizoensplakboek.zomer_hoe: In summer the planters are full of sunflowers. Three wheat on top: a straw sun hat!
gui.guhs.knus.seizoensplakboek.zomer_guh: A guh with a sun hat
Your tame guh kept their snoot out of the sun with a sun hat. Lovely and chonky.
gui.guhs.knus.seizoensplakboek.herfst_ho: In fall the leaf piles grow big and soft. Jump in from a little height: wheeeee!
gui.guhs.knus.seizoensplakboek.herfst_gu: In the leaves with your guh
Your tame guh jumped into the leaf pile with you and had a good roll through it.
gui.guhs.knus.seizoensplakboek.winter_sn: Two snow blocks stacked, a snowguh head on top: a Snowman Guh! (Counts in winter.)
gui.guhs.knus.seizoensplakboek.winter_gu: Your tame guh wore a cozy little scarf in winter. Warm and wahoog.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelvriendjes.pluisje.i: Hi! I'm Fluffy. My house has the fluffiest ears in all of Snuggledale. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelvriendjes.knabbeltj: I'm Nibbles and I can smell cheese nibbles from waaay far away. Got one on you, by any chance? Nyeg?
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelvriendjes.dikkie.in: Hello, I'm Chubbs. I'm not too chonky, you know. You can never be too chonky! Just not wahoog enough.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelvriendjes.mollie.in: Hi hi, I'm Molly! I'm a little shy... but you're welcome to stay a while.
I'm Freckles, the littlest in the dale! But my ears are HUGE. Nyeg.
I'm Dumpling, I live next to the playground. Slide! Swing! Climbing dome! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.knabbelbroodj: Nibble Dough + Roll + Nibble Crumbs. Baker Crusty's very first recipe: early in the morning the whole dale smells of it.
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.kaaskrakeling: Cheese Dough + Braid + Powdered Sugar. Crusty braids them with his ears. Honest, nyeg.
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.vadsvlaai.inf: Sweet Dough + Tart + Cheese. For when you're not WAHOOG enough: a whole pie full of cheese.
Puff Pastry + Crescent + Cheese. It looks at you so sweetly you hardly dare to eat it. Hardly.
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.knabbelkoekje: Nibble Dough + Disc + Powdered Sugar. Small and quick: a cookie for the road.
Cheese Dough + Roll + Cheese. Soft, warm and cheesy. Guhs call it 'a cuddle you can eat'.
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.pluismuffin.i: Sweet Dough + Roll + Pink Icing. With two little icing ears. So fluffy you float away.
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.theetaartje.i: Puff Pastry + Tart + Powdered Sugar. Mrs. Teaspoon orders three every day, to go with her tea.
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.knabbeltompou: Puff Pastry + Disc + Pink Icing. Pink icing, yellow cream: nobody eats one without making a mess.
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.vadsdonut.inf: Sweet Dough + Ring + Pink Icing. With rainbow sprinkles. Every baby guh's favorite.
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.guhwafel.info: Sweet Dough + Disc + Powdered Sugar. A round waffle. Merguhs take it down to the bottom of the sea.
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.sterrenkoekje: Nibble Dough + Star + Pink Icing. Baked by starlight. Professor Twinkle swears by them.
gui.guhs.knus.slaapliedjes.sterretjes.in: Out there walks a cheese nibble... no wait, out there twinkles a little star. The very first song Miss Snuggles teaches you: rock slowly, to and fro.
gui.guhs.knus.slaapliedjes.maantje.info: A soft little waltz about the moon watching over the Guhmension. It makes the baby guhs all chonky and sleepy.
gui.guhs.knus.slaapliedjes.knabbeltje.in: A bouncy song about a cheese nibble under your pillow, for when you wake up tomorrow. But no eating it in bed, nyeg!
gui.guhs.knus.slaapliedjes.wolkje.info: Slowly drifting down, like a pink little cloud sinking off to sleep. The last song: after this, everyone really is asleep. Zzz.
gui.guhs.knus.theesoorten.knabbelthee.in: Mrs. Teaspoon's house tea: brewed from cheese nibbles in a little teapot. Makes you Snug for half a minute.
gui.guhs.knus.theesoorten.kaasmelkthee.i: Tea with cheese milk from the Guh Farm. So creamy that every nasty effect melts right away.
Tea herb from your own little garden in a teapot: fresh green tea that perks you right up.
gui.guhs.knus.theesoorten.guhbloementhee: Guh flowers make pink tea that smells like spring. The snuggest tea of all.
gui.guhs.knus.kapsels.kapsel_krullen.inf: A mop of chonky little curls, everywhere. Can't comb it, can cuddle it.
gui.guhs.knus.kapsels.kapsel_kuifje.info: A tough little quiff pointing forward: that way to the cheese nibbles!
gui.guhs.knus.kapsels.kapsel_knotjes.inf: Two buns on top, like two cheese rolls. Super cute.
gui.guhs.knus.kapsels.kapsel_strikjes.in: Two pigtails with white bows. For when your guh wants to look extra sweet.
gui.guhs.knus.kapsels.kapsel_pluisbol.in: One enormous puffball: the ears just poke right through. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knus.kapsels.kapsel_vlechtjes.i: Two long braids with a little bow at the end. Almost down to the pawsies!
gui.guhs.knus.kapsels.kapsel_hanenkam.in: A mohawk made of fluff: tough at the front, sweet at the back.
gui.guhs.knus.kapsels.kapsel_matje.info: Business in the front, party in the back. The famous guh mullet.
gui.guhs.knus.kapsels.haarverf_regenboog: Rainbow hair keeps changing color, just like a Rainbow Guh. Only at Curly's!
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.kapper_eigen_guh: Took your own guh to the barber
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.tuintjes_guhs: Watered by a tame guh ten times
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.tuintjes_zang: Five plants grown by guh singing
gui.guhs.knus.tuinboek.knabbelzaadjes.in: Plant them in a guh flower pot or guh veggie planter. Water helps, and so do singing guhs!
gui.guhs.knus.tuinboek.knabbelgraan.info: Golden ears full of crunchy little cheese nibble kernels. Baker Crusty makes dough out of them.
Small and green. A tame guh loves to water them, nyeg.
gui.guhs.knus.tuinboek.theekruid.info: A bunch of mint-green herb with little white flowers. Mrs. Teaspoon makes tea from it.
gui.guhs.knus.tuinboek.guhbloemzaadjes.i: Pink seeds with little dots. What might come out? A flower that looks back at you!
gui.guhs.knus.tuinboek.guhbloemetje.info: A pink flower with little ears and a little face. Five make a party bouquet for the Cozyfest.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.grote_knabbel: A giant cheese nibble with a little hole. The most famous guh stars in the whole sky: whoever finds it always gets a little more wahoog. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.kleine_vads.i: A little guh head with two little ears. Baby guhs always look for it first, because it looks like them.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.guhoor.info: One big, round guh ear. Grandpa Guh says it's listening for Mikas sneaking up.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.vluchtende_mi: A Mika running off with a sack of stolen cheese nibbles. That's why the guhs aren't wahoog enough! He's been running for a thousand years and never gets anywhere.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.kaasschaaf.in: A handle and a little blade: the stars of cheese slicing. Handy for extra-thin nibbles.
A guh fast asleep, with a Z above it. Zzz... chonk.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.frituurpannet: A round little pan with a long handle. That's where the stars get fried, they say.
A big, round, WAHOOG belly. That's how a guh should look after a good party!
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.guhstaart.inf: A curly little tail made of stars. It wags a bit if you look long enough.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.knuffelhart.i: A heart for everyone you cuddle. It shines brightest over Snuggledale.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.luchtballon.i: A hot-air balloon with a basket: Captain Cloudy's favorite constellation.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.kampvuur.info: A little flame on two little logs: Grandpa Guh's favorite constellation.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.gouden_guh.in: RARE (only during a star shower): a whole guh face of golden stars. Whoever sees it gets three wishes, says Professor Twinkle. Or one really big one.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.vallende_knab: RARE (only during a star shower): a cheese nibble with a long tail, on its way to a hungry guh.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.guhkroon.info: RARE (only during a star shower): the crown of the King Guh, with five points.
gui.guhs.knus.ballonstempels.guhgezichtv: A guh face made of flowers, so big you can only see it from the sky. The festival guhs plant it again every year.
gui.guhs.knus.ballonstempels.wolkenpoort: A cloud to fly right through. Inside it smells of cheese nibbles, says Captain Cloudy. (That's not true.)
gui.guhs.knus.ballonstempels.hoogste_pun: The very highest point of all the balloon flights. From up here you can see the whole Guhmension, and a little bit of tomorrow.
gui.guhs.knus.ballonstempels.regenboogbo: A rainbow that pops up in the bend. Captain Cloudy says he painted it himself. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.knus.ballonstempels.reuzenguh.i: The biggest guh balloon of the whole festival. It always lies half-inflated in the grass, because it's a bit of a chonk.
gui.guhs.knus.ballonstempels.hartjeswolk: A little heart-shaped cloud: whoever sees it gets extra cuddles that day. It's science.
gui.guhs.knus.ballonstempels.branderspro: One big WHOOMPH from the burner and the balloon jumps up. Every baby guh's favorite bit.
gui.guhs.knus.ballonstempels.guhmensie_u: The prettiest view over the Guhmension. Captain Cloudy always goes a little quiet up there.
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.kamperen_uitgesla: A whole night in a sleeping bag
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.kamperen_marshmal: Toasted 5 marshmallow nibbles at the campfire
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.kamperen_pyjamafe: Pajama party: 5 guhs in pajamas at a story
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.eerste_kaas: How a star that fell into the cheese sauce became the first cheese nibble, and the littlest guh was the first to shout WAHOOG.
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.mika_die_ni: About the very first Mika, who hid all his nibbles, and the guhs who brought him a cake instead of getting angry.
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.groot_vadsf: The party with the cake as tall as a tree, the crumb trail, and the Crumb Mika who got to join the feast after all.
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.pluk_niet_v: About Pip, whose nibbles kept getting stolen, and the friends who kept searching until he was all wahoog again.
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.grote_oren: Why Guhs Have Such Big Ears
Why the guhs got such big round ears: from all that listening for Mikas sneaking up.
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.knabbelberg: The Nibble Mountain at the End of the World
About the Guh End, the floating islands and the Nibble Mountain, where the Mikas keep all the stolen cheese nibbles.
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.grote_knabb: How the Big Nibble Got into the Sky
The guh who showed their prettiest cheese nibble to the moon, so now it hangs among the stars forever.
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.wolkjes_eer: How Cloudy flew above the clouds for the first time in a balloon made of old guh socks, and became Captain Cloudy.
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.kaasregen: The Day It Rained Cheese Nibbles
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.kaasregen.i: The first cheese shower, when all the guhs ran outside with their mouths wide open and even the Mikas forgot to steal.
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.verdwaalde_: About the baby guh who got lost in the woods and found their mama again by singing.
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.mika_met_go: The Mika with the Heart of Gold
About the best nibble thief of all the Mikas, who one night gave everything back, plus a few extra.
Grandpa Guh's most favorite story of all: how a cold, bare valley turned into soft pink Snuggledale, straight out of a guh's dream.
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.vadseendje.info: An extra-round ducky with a chonky little tummy. You can never be too chonky, just not wahoog enough yet. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.kaaseendje.info: Yellow with little holes, just like a piece of cheese. Smells a bit like cheese nibbles. Nyeg, don't eat it!
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.guheendje.info: A ducky with little guh ears and pink blushies. It doesn't say quack, it says guh.
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.badmeestereendj: With a red cap and a whistle, just like Lifeguard Bubbles. Tweeeet, no running!
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.pluiseendje.inf: Super soft and pink, with a fluffy little quiff. Only floats in the Pink Funnel.
Has a spiral on its tummy and is a little dizzy. Only found in the Pink Funnel.
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.sterreneendje.i: Dark blue with glowing little stars. You'll only find it in the Glow Tunnel.
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.glimeendje.info: It glows all over in the dark! Only in the Glow Tunnel. Glow glow, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.maaneendje.info: A sleepy ducky with a nightcap and a little moon. Only in the Glow Tunnel. Zzz... quack.
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.duikeendje.info: With a snorkel and goggles, ready for the Big Splash. Only found there.
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.plonseendje.inf: Sky blue with a little water crown: the little king of the Big Splash.
gui.guhs.knus.badeendjes.gouden_eendje.i: The rarest ducky in the whole Snuggle Pool! It shines like a golden cheese nibble. Whoever grabs it is super wahoog.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.normal.info: The very first plushie: a regular, soft, chonky guh. Squeeze it and it squeaks.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.mint.info: Fresh as a mint and just as soft.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.choco.info: Smells a little like chocolate. Don't eat it, nyeg.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.snow.info: White as fresh snow, warm as a blankie.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.brontosaurus.i: With a long neck, so it can peek over the other plushies.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.golden.info: A shiny golden guh. The fair guhs are jealous of it.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.rainbow.info: All the colors at once. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.starry.info: Purple with little stars: perfect for falling asleep with.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.ghost.info: A little see-through. Boo! (It's very sweet.)
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.teckel.info: Extra long, so extra much to cuddle.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.brococolief.in: In its pink onesie. What the note said, it won't tell.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.ender.info: With tiny little wings. It doesn't fly, but it does cuddle.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.koning.info: With a little crown and a white mane. His Chonkiness.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.wolk.info: A little cloud on its head and as light as a bit of fluff.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.zeemeerguh.inf: With a fish tail. Fits just right in your bathtub.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.mager.info: A little gray and thin... quick, give it a cheese nibble!
Gold and pink, with little wings: the wahoogest plushie of the Guh End.
Green-and-yellow spotted, and it smells ever so softly of cheese sauce.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.asguh.info: Gray with glowing little cheeks, but it's not hot at all.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.pluisguh.info: Super fluffy, with a little quiff. From Snuggledale!
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.pinguh.info: Black and white with an orange snoot. It doesn't waddle, but it does cuddle. From the Guh Polder!
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelkast.glitter.info: Very rare: a plushie full of glitter that glows a little in the dark. It slips out of the claw easily!
gui.guhs.knus.ijsjes.roze.info: Strawberry cheese. It gives you blushies.
gui.guhs.knus.ijsjes.mint.info: Fresh mint with cheese flakes. Makes you run a bit faster for a while.
gui.guhs.knus.ijsjes.choco.info: Chocolate cheese: suddenly you feel as light as a bit of fluff.
gui.guhs.knus.ijsjes.bloesem.info: Spring only: pink blossom with cheese. Blushies and a warm feeling.
gui.guhs.knus.ijsjes.zonnetje.info: Summer only: lemon cheese with a little sun on top. Floaty and fast!
gui.guhs.knus.ijsjes.appeltaart.info: Fall only: apple pie with cheese and crumbs. Warm on the inside.
gui.guhs.knus.ijsjes.sneeuw.info: Winter only: snow-white vanilla cheese. Brr... and still yummy.
gui.guhs.knus.liedjesboek.toonladder.inf: Do re mi fa so la ti do: from the lowest bar to the highest. Every guh's first song.
gui.guhs.knus.liedjesboek.vader_guh.info: Are you sleeping, are you sleeping, Brother Guh? Nibble bells are ringing... (Nobody sings along during nap time.)
gui.guhs.knus.liedjesboek.altijd_vads.in: Twinkle, twinkle, little guh, chonky in your nibble bag. No, not too chonky: just not wahoog enough yet!
gui.guhs.knus.liedjesboek.alle_guhtjes: All the Guhlings Swim in Cheese Sauce
gui.guhs.knus.liedjesboek.alle_guhtjes.i: All the guhlings swim in cheese sauce, tra-la-la-la-lee, tra-la-la-la-lauce!
gui.guhs.knus.liedjesboek.maneschijn: By the Light of the Nibble Moon
gui.guhs.knus.liedjesboek.maneschijn.inf: By the light of the nibble moon, under the pink moon of the Guhmension.
gui.guhs.knus.liedjesboek.ode_aan_de_kna: The most solemn guh song of all: about the very first cheese nibble. It makes Grandpa Guh teary.
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.wereldleven_ijsco: Met Jingles the Ice Cream Guh
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.wereldleven_ijsje: Seven cheese ice creams eaten or given
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.wereldleven_gezwa: Waved at by a guh ten times
gui.guhs.knus.piepboek.pieppiepmuisje.in: A teeny-tiny plush mousie: dark purple, with a fluffy cream band around its tummy and a shiny pink nose. It lives in the sweet guh houses of the Guhmension (about one per ten guhs) and adores cheese nibbles. Tame it with a nibble, carry it on your shoulder and play hide-and-seek: it squeaks until you find it!
gui.guhs.knus.piepboek.poepschilly.info: A brown plush sea turtle (with a cream tummy), from the coast of the guh sea. Poopshelly has a very special job: he waddles up to a guh's little bottom, crawls inside and scrubs everything sparkling clean from the inside out. It tickles terribly (the guh wiggles, giggles and blows soap bubbles), and then: plop, there he is again! After that the guh is Fresh Inside: faster and sparkly. Very tidy! (Right-click your Poopshelly for his little menu: Polish a Tushie!) (Note: Poopshelly is the bottom scrubber. His lookalike Shelly looks a lot like him, but doesn't scrub anything.)
gui.guhs.knus.piepboek.schilly.info: Shelly looks a whole lot like Poopshelly, but it really is a different turtle (look closely!). Shelly doesn't scrub guhs: Shelly is a tiny-head. That's why guh and Shelly sometimes have beef and turn their backs on each other in a huff... but they're also true besties, so they always make up again. Right-click your tame Shelly (little menu: Bestie Moment!) and then a guh.
gui.guhs.knus.piepboek.roze_guh_koek.inf: A pink iced cookie with big shiny blue eyes and a little snoot. They come six to a tray. Whoever eats one looks so sweet that the guhs get hearts from it (and are easier to tame). The recipe is in the treasure of the Cheese Nibble Nest.
A cheese nibble with angry eyebrows. Not a guh (a snack!), so it's allowed to be angry. It hops at you and pushes a little. Once defeated it turns out to be mostly... sadsie. It leaves regular cheese nibbles behind.
The biggest, angriest cheese nibble of the nest, with a little crown. It stomps so hard you go flying (jump in time!) and calls for help when things go badly. But really... it was just sadsie.
gui.guhs.band.knuffel_rust: %s is still all warm from the last cuddle. Again in a bit, nyeg!
gui.guhs.band.knuffel_nu_niet: %s can't cuddle right now (they're very busy).
gui.guhs.band.niveau.geen: on the way to sweet chonkies...
gui.guhs.band.plek.slaapt_in_huisje: Snoring away in Guh House %1$s (%2$s, %3$s %4$s %5$s). Zzz...
gui.guhs.band.plek.rijdt_op: %1$s is riding on top (%2$s, %3$s %4$s %5$s). Go go!
gui.guhs.band.plek.item_grond: Lying on the ground like a little parcel (%2$s, %3$s %4$s %5$s). Nyeg, pick them up!
gui.guhs.band.plek.guhwiel: Running laps in a Guh Wheel (%2$s, %3$s %4$s %5$s). WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.band.plek.guhkamer: Having a sleepover in the Guh Room in your Guhbelly
gui.guhs.band.plek.onbekend: No idea, nyeg... Come by sometime, then your Guhdex will remember!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.getemd.tekst: Today I got an owner. They gave me a cheese nibble and that was it, I was sold. Nyeg, that's how easy I am.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.eerste_aai.tekst: A hand went over my fur. I'm still a little shy about it. One more time?
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.eerste_knuffel.t: My owner cuddled me so hard my chonk wobbled. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.eerste_rit.tekst: Someone sat on my back. Apparently I'm a horse now. A very chonky horse.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.eerste_guhmensio: Everything is pink here! The grass, the clouds, me. I feel right at home.
It's dark here and a little scary, nyeg. Good thing my owner is here too.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.eerste_huisje.te: I have a little house that looks like my own head. My ears are the roof. Makes total sense.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.eerste_lief.teks: We are now officially sweet chonkies together. I wrote it in my diary, so it's real.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.eerste_mega.teks: Mega sweet chonkies together! My little heart is so big it barely fits in my chonk anymore.
Soulguh bff 5evr <3. Forever. This is never going away. Never. Nyeg nyeg nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.eerste_klusje.te: I worked! Really worked! Now I do need a little rest, a tiny nap or three.
Toys! I didn't know those existed. My life is now complete.
I'm having a sleepover in my owner's belly. Sounds weird, but it's super snug in here.
We played a game together. I cheered so hard my little ears flapped.
I made a buddy. We're chonkies together now. Not as chonky as with my owner, though.
My owner knows a little secret about me now. Shh, don't tell anyone, nyeg.
gui.guhs.klus.opgraven.tip: Digs up cheese nibbles in grass, dirt or sand in the chore area. Sometimes finds something rare, nyeg! Put a chest next to the house for the loot. (Guhs and mousies)
gui.guhs.klus.farmen.tip: Harvests ripe crops and replants them right away: wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, cheese nibble plants and guh gardens. Waters thirsty gardens. (Guhs)
gui.guhs.klus.opruimen.tip: Picks up stuff lying around and brings it to the chest. Is there a Bank Guh in the chore area? Then everything gets sorted, including what's in the chest. Needs: a chest or Bank Guh. (Guhs and mousies)
gui.guhs.klus.dieren.tip: Pets and feeds guh lambs, nibble chicks and guh cows, picks up wool and eggs and collects eggs from the chicken nests. Harvests full nibble hives. Put nibble feed and empty bottles (for cheese milk) in the chest! (Guhs)
gui.guhs.klus.bakken.tip: Brings nibble grain from the chest to a guh windmill and the flour back, and bakes treats in a nibble oven when the chest has everything for a recipe. Nibble flour = twice as much! (Guhs)
gui.guhs.klus.vissen.tip: Catches guhfish and seashells when there's a little pond (3+ water blocks) in the chore area. Very rarely a Golden Guhfish! (Guhs, Shelly and Poopshelly)
gui.guhs.klus.waken.tip: Squeaks and runs to you when a Mika or monster comes near the house, and pushes Mikas away ever so gently. Never fighting, always sweet! (Guhs; mousies only squeak)
gui.guhs.klus.plukken.tip: Picks nibbleberries and sweet berries, and a little flower at any flower (which stays put): every kind of flower, most often a pink guh flower. Sometimes plants a new flower. (Guhs and mousies)
gui.guhs.klus.lampjes.tip: Turns on the guh lamps and candles in the chore area in the evening, and off again in the morning, with a big yawn. (Guhs)
gui.guhs.klus.oppas.tip: Cuddles and feeds squeaksqueak mice, Shelly and Poopshelly nearby. A hurt guh gets a snack from the chest (cupcake, cookie, cheese nibbles...). (Guhs)
gui.guhs.huisje.gebouwd: Your Guh House is called %s! Right-click it to choose residents and chores.
gui.guhs.huisje.trekt_in: %s now lives in Guh House %s. Welcome home, nyeg!
gui.guhs.huisje.vol: Guh House %s is full! Build another one, or a bigger one.
gui.guhs.huisje.niet_jouw_guh: Only your own tame guhs and buddies can live there, nyeg.
gui.guhs.huisje.niet_van_jou: Guh House %s belongs to someone else. No peeking inside!
gui.guhs.huisje.naam_bezet: That name is empty, too long or already taken by another house. Think of something else, nyeg!
gui.guhs.huisje.opslag.bank: Chore loot goes to the Bank Guh (sorted!)
gui.guhs.huisje.opslag.kist: Chore loot goes in the chest next to the house
gui.guhs.huisje.opslag.deur: Put a chest next to the house! Right now the loot ends up on the doorstep.
gui.guhs.huisje.leeg: Nobody lives here yet. Click New Resident, or right-click the house with a picked-up guh or a buddy.
gui.guhs.huisje.nieuwe_bewoner.tooltip: Your own tame guhs and buddies that are close by (16 blocks) can come live here.
gui.guhs.huisje.koepel.tooltip: Show the chore area: a blue dome over the area where the residents wander, do chores and play.
gui.guhs.huisje.geen_klusjes: No chores known yet, nyeg! Your residents live here snugly, sleep here and play nearby.
gui.guhs.huisje.kies_bewoner: Pick a resident on the left to turn their chores on or off. These are all the chores (and what they need):
gui.guhs.huisje.baby: Babies don't do chores yet: they're still too little, they just get to play.
gui.guhs.huisje.geen_kandidaten: There are no tame guhs or buddies of yours nearby that don't live here yet.
gui.guhs.huisje.verhuis: Lives in %s now. Click: move house!
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.knop.tooltip: What's possible here? See which chores your residents can do around this house and what they can play with.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.uitleg.klusjes: Can the chore be done in the chore area right now? Point at a chore to see what it needs.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.uitleg.dingen: No chore to do for a moment? Then your residents sometimes go and play. This is what's in the chore area:
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ververs.toolti: Take a fresh look around the chore area. Also happens by itself every few seconds.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.bewoners.ja: Residents of this house who can do it: %s (turned on for %s).
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.bewoners.nee: Nobody who can do this lives in this house yet.
grass, dirt, sand or moss in the chore area with two blocks of air above it. Not right up against the house.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.farmen.gr: Nothing ripe right now. Still growing: %s
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.farmen.no: a little field of crops (wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, cheese nibble plants...) or a planted guh garden in the chore area. Ripe ones get harvested and replanted, a thirsty garden gets water.
No chest or Bank Guh to put the stuff in
Nothing on the ground, but the chest can be sorted into the Bank Guh
All tidy: nothing lying around right now
a chest next to the house or a Bank Guh in the chore area. Then they pick up whatever lies on the ground in the chore area.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.dieren.te: Nothing to do right now: the animals are happy and there's nothing to collect
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.dieren.ge: No farm animals, chicken nests or nibble hives
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.dieren.no: guh lambs, nibble chicks or guh cows in the chore area, a chicken nest with eggs or a full nibble hive. Put nibble feed and empty bottles in the chest!
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.bakken.ba: Ready to bake: the chest has everything for a recipe
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.bakken.me: Nibble flour to pick up at the windmill: %s
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.bakken.ma: There's nibble grain in the chest for the windmill
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.bakken.ge: The guh windmill has nothing to do right now: no flour to pick up and no nibble grain to bring
There's a nibble oven, but the chest doesn't have everything for a recipe
Nothing to bake or grind: the chest doesn't have everything for a recipe and there's no grain or flour to carry
No nibble oven or guh windmill
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.bakken.no: a nibble oven or a guh windmill in the chore area. And in the chest: nibble grain for the windmill, or everything for a recipe from the recipe book for the oven.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.vissen.te: Not enough water: %s of the 3 blocks
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.vissen.ge: There's water (%s blocks), but no spot at the edge to sit on
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.vissen.no: a little pond of at least 3 water source blocks in the chore area, with air above them (flowing water doesn't count). And next to it a free spot on solid ground to sit on.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.waken.rus: Always on guard. All quiet right now.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.waken.gev: There's a Mika or monster near the house right now!
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.waken.nod: nothing! When a Mika or monster comes near the house, they squeak and run to you. Guhs gently push Mikas away, mousies only squeak.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.plukken.b: Flowers to pick a little flower at: %s
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.plukken.l: Nothing to pick right now: the berries are still growing or the flowers are resting
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.plukken.n: nibbleberry bushes, sweet berry bushes or flowers in the chore area: every small flower, plus the sunflower, lilac, rose bush and peony (no wither rose). The bush and the flower stay put. A flower rests for 5 minutes afterwards.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.lampjes.t: Lights: %s. They go on in the evening and off in the morning, not right now.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.lampjes.n: guh lamps or candles in the chore area (the tag guhs:klusjes/lampjes). On in the evening, off again in the morning.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.oppas.ver: All the buddies were just cuddled and no guh is hurt
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.oppas.gee: No buddies nearby and no hurt guh
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.oppas.nod: buddies of yours in the chore area (squeaksqueak mice, Shelly, Poopshelly...) or a hurt guh of yours. Each buddy gets a cuddle every 2 minutes. Put snacks and cheese nibbles in the chest!
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.polijsten: Cobblestones in the chest to polish: %s
cobblestones in the chest next to the house or in the Bank Guh. Mossy cobblestone and cobbled deepslate work too.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ding.knabbelba: Guhs chase it and nudge it with their snoot until the cheese nibble pops out. Munch!
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ding.guh_glijb: Guhs climb up the frame and slide down. Wheee!
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ding.pluizige_: Guhs and squeaksqueak mice run through it: in one hole, out the other. Pieces that are joined together count as one tunnel.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ding.guh_wip: A guh sits on it and seesaws, best of all together with a friend.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ding.guh_schom: A guh sits on it and swings happily back and forth.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ding.jukebox: Is a record playing? Then the guhs within 8 blocks happily dance along.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ding.kampvuur: Late in the evening, guhs within 7 blocks of the fire put on their pajamas and nightcap, right before they go inside.
gui.guhs.klusjes.waken.hier: Squeak squeak! %1$s comes to warn you: watch out, %2$s at %3$s!
gui.guhs.klusjes.waken.ver: Squeak squeak! %1$s sends a warning from %3$s: there's %2$s sneaking around the house, nyeg!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_opgraven: I dug a hole and there was a cheese nibble in it! The ground is really just one big nibble tin, nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_farmen.t: I picked wheat and planted it again right away. That's called farming. I'm a farmer now. With a chonk.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_opruimen: I tidied up everything that was on the ground. A pebble too. The pebble is in the chest now. You're welcome.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_dieren.t: I petted a guh lamb. The lamb petted me back. I think. Anyway, it was very soft.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_bakken.t: I baked! Something yummy came out of the oven and I did NOT eat it. Well, almost.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_vissen.t: I caught a fish with my pawsies. The fish was just as surprised as I was, nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_waken.te: A Mika came to our house. I squeaked really loudly. I'm very brave. A little. From a distance.
I picked berries. A few of them ended up in the chest. The rest are in my chonk. Oopsie.
I turned on the lights, so nobody has to sit in the dark. In the morning I turn them off again. With a yawn.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_oppas.te: I looked after a mousie. The mousie looked after me. Now we're both very well looked after.
gui.guhs.speelgoed.glijbaan.bezet: Someone's already sliding, nyeg! Wait your turn.
gui.guhs.speelgoed.tunnel.leeg: Knock knock... nobody's in there. Not yet, nyeg.
gui.guhs.speelgoed.tunnel.gevonden: Found you! %s giggles and comes out of the tunnel.
gui.guhs.speelgoed.tunnel.muisje: %s found %s in the tunnel! Squeak squeak!
gui.guhs.speelgoed.bal.gevuld: There's a cheese nibble in the nibble ball again. Who's going to push it out?
gui.guhs.guhkamer.gegroeid: Your Guh Room has grown! Now %s x %s blocks, room for %s sleepover guhs. Thank you, soulguh!
gui.guhs.guhkamer.groeit_straks: A new soulguh! Your Guh Room grows as soon as you step inside again.
gui.guhs.guhkamer.even_geduld: %s is still fast asleep in the Guh Room... try again in a moment, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhkamer.gestuurd: %s is off for a cozy sleepover in your Guh Room. Bye-bye!
gui.guhs.guhkamer.vol: Your Guh Room is full! It grows with every soulguh bff 5evr <3.
gui.guhs.guhkamer.geen_maag: You don't have a Guhbelly yet, nyeg! Do the belly quest first.
gui.guhs.guhkamer.niet_jouw: Only your own tame guhs can have a sleepover in your Guh Room.
gui.guhs.guhkamer.prive: %s's belly isn't public: the Guh Room stays closed.
gui.guhs.guhkamer.welkom_thuis: Welcome to your Guh Room! %s guhs are sleeping over here.
gui.guhs.guhkamer.welkom_bezoek: Welcome to %s's Guh Room! Looking is fine, no petting.
gui.guhs.guhkamer.bel.groei: Your Guh Room grows with every guh that's soulguh bff 5evr <3 (now %s). Then there's more room!
gui.guhs.guhkamer.bel.stuur: Click: %s goes for a sleepover in the Guh Room
gui.guhs.guhkamer.bel.niemand_bij: None of your guhs nearby. They need to be within 24 blocks.
gui.guhs.guhkamer.bel.niemand_logeert: Nobody is sleeping over in your Guh Room yet. Send a guh there!
gui.guhs.guhkamer.bel.geen_maag: You don't have a Guhbelly yet. The Guh Room is in your belly: do the belly quest first!
gui.guhs.samen.samen_gespeeld: ♥ %s played %s with you! Playing together = hearts.
gui.guhs.samen.kart: ♥ %s hops on the back! Racing together, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.samen.zwemmen: ♥ %s swims along with you. Splish splash, nyeg!
gui.guhs.samen.troost: ♥ %s was already waiting for you and gives you a comfort cuddle. Nyeg, so glad you're back!
gui.guhs.samen.welkom: ♥ %s is SO happy you're back! Welcome home, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.samen.onweer: Brr, thunderstorm! %s snuggles up close to you. Cuddle!
gui.guhs.samen.welterusten: %s waves you good night. Sleep chonky-tight, nyeg!
gui.guhs.samen.welterusten_meer: %s and %s more guhs wave you good night. Sleep chonky-tight, nyeg!
gui.guhs.samen.bff: ♥ You and %s give each other a big BFF hug! Soulguh bff 5evr <3
gui.guhs.samen.vriendjes: ♥ %s and %s are buddies now! Nyeg, how sweet.
gui.guhs.samen.besties: ♥ %s and %s are BEST buddies now! A real bff duo. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.samen.emote_ontgrendeld: ♥ Unlocked by your hearts: the %s emote! Pick it in your guh's Emotes menu.
gui.guhs.samen.emote_op_slot: %s is still locked: first become %s with a guh.
gui.guhs.samen.halsbandje: ♥ The Golden Heart Collar is yours! The prettiest thing a guh can wear, and you can only get it with a soulguh. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.samen.bff_uitleg: Tip: pick the BFF Hug in the Emotes menu while standing right next to your guh: then you really hug each other.
gui.guhs.emotes.op_slot: Locked, nyeg! First become %s with a guh.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_bestie.tek: Now I have a BEST buddy. That's a buddy, but with extra cheese nibbles.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_op_reis.te: We walked and walked and walked. I don't know where we were going, but it was together, so it was good.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_kart: On the back of the kart
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_kart.tekst: I rode on the back of a race kart! My cheeks were flapping. Again, NOW.
I can skate! Well, slide on my tummy. But very gracefully.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_zwemmen.te: I swam next to my owner in the Snuggle Pool. Guhs float really well, thanks to the chonk.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_troost.tek: My owner was gone for a while and came back very tired. I gave a cuddle. Cuddles make everything better.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_welkom.tek: My owner was gone sooo long. When they came back I did a little dance. A really big little dance.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_onweer.tek: The sky was rumbling. I wasn't scared, okay, I just wanted to sit really close to my owner.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_welteruste: My owner went to sleep and I waved. Another chonky day tomorrow, nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.samen_bff_knuffe: The biggest hug ever, with a heart above it. The heart was real, I saw it.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.alle: ★ You now know ALL of %s's faves! You two really are sweet chonkies together. WAHOOG! ★
gui.guhs.favorietjes.neuriet: ♪ %1$s is humming their favorite song (%2$s): they're in the mood! A happy guh cheers louder! ♪
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.eten.0: %s looks curiously at the snack... almost! Something like this is their very favorite, nyeg!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.eten.1: %s perks up their ears: mmm, this tastes ALMOST like their favorite snack. Warm, warm!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.eten.2: %s licks their snoot and looks at you hopefully. Something like that, but juuust a bit different... nyeg?
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.eten.0: %s sniffs... smacks... nyeg? Yummy, sure, but not their very favorite snack.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.eten.1: %s chews politely. It's sweetly meant, but their favorite snack is something totally different. Cold!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.eten.2: %s sniffs it and goes a little cross-eyed. Nyeg? Try something totally different!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.plek.0: %s looks around curiously... it almost smells like their favorite spot here!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.plek.1: %s pitter-patters in excited circles. This looks like their favorite spot, but it's juuust not it. Warm!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.plek.2: %s sniffs the air: their favorite spot is a lot like this spot, nyeg!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.plek.0: %s sniffs the ground... nyeg? Nice here, but their favorite spot is somewhere else entirely.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.plek.1: %s gives a yawn. Nice view, but nothing to wiggle about. Cold, cold!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.plek.2: %s looks around and shrugs their little shoulders. Keep looking, nyeg!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.knuffel.0: %s hugs the plushie and looks up curiously... that kind of plushie is almost their favorite plushie!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.knuffel.1: %s presses their snoot into the plushie: warm! Their very favorite plushie looks a bit like this one.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.knuffel.2: %s giggles softly. Almost, almost! Their favorite plushie is a little cousin of this one, nyeg.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.knuffel.0: %s sniffs the plushie... nyeg? Soft, but not their very favorite.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.knuffel.1: %s gives the plushie a polite pat. Cold! Their favorite plushie is totally different.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.knuffel.2: %s looks at the plushie, the plushie looks back. No spark. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.liedje.0: %s wiggles along curiously... that kind of song is almost their favorite song!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.liedje.1: %s hums a few notes along and then stops. Warm! Their song sounds a bit like this.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.liedje.2: %s waves their ears to the beat: almost! Try another song of the same kind.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.liedje.0: %s listens politely... nyeg? Nice tune, but not their favorite song.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.liedje.1: %s taps along with one pawsie and then almost falls asleep. Cold!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.liedje.2: %s sniffs the music (turns out you can). Nyeg? Maybe a totally different kind of song!
%s plays curiously... this kind of playing is almost their favorite toy, nyeg!
%s runs excited little laps. Warm! You play with their very favorite toy in just the same way.
%s squeaks happily: almost! Try a toy you play with in the same way.
%s sniffs the toy... nyeg? Fun, but not their favorite toy.
%s plays along for a bit and then sits down comfily. Cold!
%s looks at you as if to say: another toy please, nyeg.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.emote.0: %s looks up curiously after their trick... that kind of trick is almost their favorite trick!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.emote.1: %s beams a little. Warm! Their very favorite trick has exactly the same mood.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.emote.2: %s is still wiggling: almost, nyeg! Try a trick that feels the same.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.emote.0: %s gives a sniff... nyeg? Nice trick, but not their very favorite.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.emote.1: %s does it nicely, but their ears stay flat. Cold!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.emote.2: %s takes a deep breath and sighs. Nyeg. Maybe a totally different trick?
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.kleur.0: %s looks at themselves curiously... this color is right next to their favorite color!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.kleur.1: %s twirls in front of a puddle. Warm! Just a shade different.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.kleur.2: %s strokes their new outfit: almost, nyeg! Their favorite color is a neighbor color.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.kleur.0: %s sniffs their outfit... nyeg? Pretty, but not their favorite color.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.kleur.1: %s looks at their outfit and then at you. Cold! A totally different color, please.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.kleur.2: %s makes a pouty snoot. It suits them fine, but it's not their color, nyeg.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.vriend.0: %s happily sniffs this guh... warm! Their very best guh buddy is a buddy of this one.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.vriend.1: %s gives a pawsie. Warm! This guh knows their very best buddy really well, nyeg.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.warm.vriend.2: %s plays along for a bit and then looks around: where's their very best buddy? Almost!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.vriend.0: %s sniffs the other guh... nyeg? Nice, but not their very favorite buddy.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.vriend.1: %s nods politely at the other guh. Cold! Their best buddy is a different guh.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.hint.koud.vriend.2: %s looks at the other guh and says: nyeg. That means: nice, but not my bff.
gui.guhs.favorietjes.ontdekt.eten: ♥ Nyeg!! %1$s munches and smacks and beams: %2$s is their FAVORITE SNACK! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.ontdekt.plek: ♥ WAHOOG! %1$s rolls through the grass with joy: %2$s is their favorite spot!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.ontdekt.knuffel: ♥ Ooooh! %1$s hugs and hugs and won't let go: %2$s is their favorite plushie!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.ontdekt.liedje: ♥ Nyeg nyeg nyeg! %1$s sings along at the top of their lungs: %2$s is their favorite song!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.ontdekt.speeltje: ♥ Wheee! %1$s can't stop anymore: %2$s is their favorite toy!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.ontdekt.emote: ♥ %1$s does it again, and again: %2$s is their favorite trick! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.ontdekt.kleur: ♥ %1$s shows off their outfit to everyone: %2$s is their favorite color! So chonky, so pretty!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.ontdekt.vriend: ♥ %1$s and %2$s are the very best buddies! Together they're twice as wahoog!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.weer.plek: ♥ %1$s hops around: back at their favorite spot, %2$s!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.weer.knuffel: ♥ %1$s hugs %2$s again, their very favorite plushie!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.weer.liedje: ♥ %1$s sings along with %2$s, their favorite song!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.weer.kleur: ♥ %1$s is wearing %2$s again, their favorite color!
gui.guhs.favorietjes.weer.vriend: ♥ %1$s is back together with %2$s, their very best buddy!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_fav_: My owner now knows what I love most of ALL. Now I'll surely get it every day. Right? Nyeg?
We were at my favorite spot! I rolled around in the grass for a bit. Three times. Four times.
I found my very favorite plushie. I'm never letting go of it. Unless a cheese nibble comes along.
My owner played MY song! I sang along so loud my little ears were trembling.
This toy is mine. Well, ours. But mostly mine, nyeg.
My owner likes my favorite trick too! I'm going to do it really often now. Really, really often.
I'm wearing my favorite color! I'm now officially the prettiest guh in the world. Says me.
My owner gets who my very best buddy is now. We do everything together. Even snoring.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_alle: My owner knows all my little secrets. All eight! Except where I hid that one cheese nibble. Shh.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_ijsj: Brrr! Cold on my snoot! One more bite. Brrr! One more bite. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_taar: I ate a pastry. Now there are crumbs in my fur and they're never coming out.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_suik: Candy! It sticks to my whiskers. This is the best day of my life.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_frui: Fruit is healthy, says my owner. It's yummy too, says me. But cheese nibbles are yummier.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_frit: Crispy! Golden brown! Chonk! I think I'm even a little chonkier now. Good, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_visj: I ate a fishy. It looked at me a little surprised. So did I.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_hapj: I've eaten a hundred snacks from my owner's hand already. My chonk grows and grows. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_stra: Sand between my toes! I built a sandcastle. Well, a sand bump.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_snee: Everything is white and cold and crunchy. My pawsies are ice cubes. But it's so pretty, nyeg!
So much water! Where does it all come from? I looked at it for a really long time.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_woes: Hot! Sandy! Not a cheese nibble in sight. Moving on quickly, nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_bloe: I sniffed all the little flowers. One of them tickled. I had to sneeze. Achoo-guh!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_padd: There were cows walking around with mushrooms on their backs. I didn't say anything. Polite, huh.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_jung: Tall trees, funny noises and a parrot that shouted 'guh'. Or was that me?
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_moer: It's soggy here and a little stinky. My pawsies went 'squish squish'. Fun sound!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_grot: It's dark and something is dripping. I was very brave. I only squeaked once.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_berg: We climbed all the way to the top. I could almost see my house! I think. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_knuf: A whole dale full of plushies and sweet guhs. I want to live here. Or at least have a sleepover.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_guhp: Windmills, ditches and ice! I didn't slip. Okay, once. Okay, three times.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_vads: The Chonkwood Forest smells of nibbleberries and adventure. I felt very tough. And a little small.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_neth: It's very hot here and very red. I almost felt like a fried cheese nibble. Quick, let's go!
The End is very quiet and there are long black things walking around. I didn't look at them. Safer.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_guhm: I've been inside my owner's belly. On the inside! It's snugger than you'd think.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_barb: It smells like barbecue here and I'm hungry. I'm always hungry, but now extra.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_knuf: I cuddled a plushie. It didn't cuddle back, but I know it wanted to.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_koor: Someone played a song on the xylophone and I sang along. I'm a singing guh now. Almost famous.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_disc: Lights! Music! I danced until my chonk shook. Disco is my thing, nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_kled: I'm wearing clothes! I'm a very fancy guh now. No more rolling in the mud. Okay, a little.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_dans: I danced while my owner was watching! My owner clapped. I think I'm a star.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_vaho: WAHOOG! I jumped so high I could smell the clouds for a moment. They smell like cotton candy.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_zing: I sang a song for my owner. It had no words, just 'nyeg'. But with lots of feeling.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_roll: I did a somersault! After that I didn't know which way was up for a bit. Again!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_reis: We've walked 1000 blocks together already! My pawsies are tired, but my little heart is happy.
Ten thousand blocks! I didn't count them all. Most of them, though. Up to twelve. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_mara: 42,195 blocks together: a real marathon! I deserve a medal. A cheese one, please.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_knuf: Ten big cuddles already! I keep a list. The list got cuddled too.
A hundred cuddles! I'm the most cuddled guh in the whole world. Definitely.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_reco: My owner set a record and I was cheering! So really it's my record too, nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_klus: A hundred chores done! I'm the hardest-working guh in the whole house. Nap time.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_spee: Played fifty times! Playing is very hard work too, you know. Especially for my little ears.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_nach: My first night in my very own house. I snored all night long. So they say. Not me.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_week: We've been together a whole week! Seven days. That's like seven times as many cuddles.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_maan: A whole month together! I know all your little secrets now. And you know mine. Well, most of them.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_hond: A hundred days! I baked a little cake. In my head. It was very yummy.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_rege: Drops on my little ears! I'm a wet guh now. Wet guhs smell like... guh.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_onwe: BOOM! I snuggled up to my owner for just a second. But I wasn't scared. Really, I wasn't. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_snee: Snowflakes fell on my snoot. I ate one. Tastes like nothing. Still yummy.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_ster: We looked at the stars together. I picked one out. Its name is Cheese Nibble.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_voll: The moon was perfectly round. Just like a cheese nibble. I looked at it for a really long time, snoot wide open.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.favorietjes_best: I have a bestie! A real one! We're soul-chonkies now. My owner is still number one, though.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.terug_uit_de_wol: I was up in the clouds for a bit, but the Snuggleheart beat and then I was back. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.huisje.van_wie: This is %1$s's house (%2$s). Only %1$s can change it.
gui.guhs.klus.polijsten.tip: Shuckly only: cobblestones in the chest become smooth stone and shiny guh pebbles
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_polijste: I polished stones. Very slowly. Very smooth. Very pretty.
gui.guhs.huisje.meldingen.tooltip: Click to turn the chat messages on or off for when a resident finds something rare (marshmallow nibble, guh crystal...). The diary always writes it down.
